payload.recallText: The narrator is recalling his experience as a writer for the Ram, a student newspaper at his college in the northeast United States. His college dean had announced a policy which would result in tuition being raised higher than the rate of inflation, such that the middle-class student base might be replaced by more presitigous, higher class students. The narrator questioned the dean about this, and he started responding with "Listen here, punk" before a figure came out and pied the dean. The narrator went back to the editor of the Ram who agreed to let him write a story over the event. The writer embellishes the truth by making the person who pied the dean into a masked, caped vigilante who shouted a latin catchphrase and kicked his feet together after pieing the dean. The story is published, and the writer receives a note telling him that the pie man will strike again at a certain time and location, and the new victim ends up being a head student who was against public drinking, with the pie man now living up to the published story and wearing a superhero outfit and reciting his reported catchphrase. The pie man continues his mission while becoming a university sensation with students dressing similarly and repeating his catchphrase during lectures. Later on the writer is in a bar when he is asked by a woman if he himself is pie man. The writer assumes that if he answers yes then she will sleep with him, and he reasons with himself that he might as well be the pie man since it was he who created his mythology. So he tells her yes and she says for him to buy her a drink and tell her about it.
